description: Known-failure baseline for the imported runtime tests (Phase 3, #29). Each test listed fails on the deployed code: identically on a full spares4repairs@13b7a50 checkout (#28), and here. None is fixed in Phase 3, because making it pass would change runtime behaviour or content. 'deployed-code-gap' means the deployed code or knowledge data does not contain or produce what the test asserts. Whether the test is stale or ahead of the code cannot be established from this repository, which has no pre-import history. That is decided when the behaviour is next worked on.

orchestration/tests/test_clarification_i.evidence: Stale against the current orchestrator API (routing.PENDING_SLOTS, routing._cue_appliance removed). Resolved with the ADR 0018 orchestrator change, which also deletes this baseline file.

error-codes/mcp/deploy/tests/test_auth.p.evidence: It runs the MCP server from error-codes/mcp/.venv, a path it hard-codes, which did not exist (FileNotFoundError). build/test/run-tests.mjs links that path to the MCP test environment. The test is unchanged and passes.
